failure_modes.name: Failure to convert localization into a correct end-to-end resolution
failure_modes.description: The system can produce structured search and bug-location outputs, but unresolved outcomes indicate that localization or subsequent execution did not reliably yield a correct solution.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient robustness on difficult SymPy issues
failure_modes.description: Both recorded SymPy probes were unresolved, suggesting weak generalization or reasoning robustness on technically complex repository issues.

failure_modes.name: Inconsistent issue-specific prioritization and context selection
failure_modes.description: The framework relies on LLM-guided action decomposition, relevance scoring, and context pruning, yet the mixed probe outcomes show that these mechanisms do not consistently identify the actionable code path.

why: The system resolved 41.0% of the SWE-bench Lite instances, so its target alignment and reasoning are only moderate and its execution accuracy is substantially weaker, despite a relatively strong structured-output interface. The probes show two successful cases but two unresolved SymPy cases, supporting good potential on some tasks but inconsistent localization-to-resolution performance.
